title: Microsoft Purview: view-only role management for Global Reader and Security Reader
summary: The briefing needs a correction to its access-review advice: Security Reader does not grant read access to every setting, and Global Reader has documented limitations. The roadmap details and the listed administration paths and commands are supported.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet
claims.claim: The access-review advice treats Global Reader and Security Reader as roles providing read access to every setting.
claims.quote: The primary difference between Global Reader and Security Reader is that a Global Reader can access **configuration and settings**.
claims.fix: Replace the first Before rollout bullet with: 'Review who holds Global Reader and Security Reader in the Microsoft Entra admin center, and remove accounts that no longer need their assigned reader role.' Security Reader is not an every-setting reader, and the cited Entra reference also documents Global Reader limitations.
